title: When Does Self-Supervised Learning Transfer to Time-Series Tasks?
abstract: arXiv:2605.19462v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) assumes that solving pretext tasks on unlabeled data yields representations that transfer effectively across downstream applications via linear probing or fine-tuning. While this paradigm has driven major progress in vision and language, its benefits for time series remain under-investigated and often confounded by inconsistent experimental controls. To address this gap, we benchmark seven representative methods from five key SSL paradigms across anomaly detection, classification, and forecasting under parameter- and data-matched budgets. We find that transfer efficacy depends heavily on the downstream task. SSL yields substantial gains in anomaly detection and provides effective initializations for classification under fine-tuning, but offers limited to no advantage over non-pre-trained controls in forecasting. translated_title: 自监督学习何时能迁移到时间序列任务？
translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）假设在无标签数据上解决前置任务所获得的表示，能够通过线性探测或微调有效迁移到各种下游应用中。虽然这一范式在视觉和语言领域推动了重大进展，但其在时间序列领域的收益仍未得到充分研究，且常因不一致的实验控制而受到混淆。为填补这一空白，我们在参数和数据匹配的预算条件下，对来自五个关键SSL范式的七种代表性方法，在异常检测、分类和预测任务上进行了基准测试。我们发现迁移效果在很大程度上取决于下游任务：SSL在异常检测中带来显著提升，并在微调设置下为分类任务提供有效的初始化，但在预测任务中相比非预训练的对照方法优势有限甚至没有优势。此外，线性探测并不能可靠地预测微调性能……
tldr: 自监督学习在时间序列上的迁移效果高度依赖于下游任务：它在异常检测中收益显著、在微调分类中可提供有效初始化，但在预测任务中几乎没有优势，且线性探测无法可靠预测微调性能。
en_tdlr: The transfer effectiveness of self-supervised learning on time-series tasks depends heavily on the downstream task—it yields substantial gains in anomaly detection and effective initializations for fine-tuned classification, but offers little to no advantage in forecasting, and linear probing does not reliably predict fine-tuning performance.
